thread:
mike: quick FYI — ran the new sampleapp onboarding and hit auth confusion. README says `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, the CLI docs mention `REDWOOD_KEY`, and the Docker example uses `PROJECT_TOKEN`. New hires are getting stuck.

jess: oh no. Which flow is breaking?

mike: when you `rw login --project myproj` the CLI picks up REDWOOD_ORG_KEY and overwrites the project scope in the local docker env. So app tries to call Dedicated model under the wrong org.

aisha: that sounds like the resolver priority is wrong — we intended: CLI args > project env > org env > kube secret. Not "org > project".

sam: I can repro. Steps: 
```
# set project key but leave org key present
export REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj_abc
export REDWOOD_ORG_KEY=org_123
./sampleapp/run.sh
```
App authenticates as org_123 every time for me.

jess: that explains a ton. Also rotation flow is busted: when you rotate the project key in the console the CLI fallback to org key during ephemeral key exchange, so streams get invalidated mid-session.

mike: sorry for the island of text — but the UX hit was immediate for a new PM pairing. They couldn't figure out why logs showed org id.

aisha: suggested quick fixes: 1) normalize env var names in README and sampleapps to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (global) and `REDWOOD_PROJECT_API_KEY` (project). 2) fix resolver order in the CLI to prefer project-scoped envs. 3) during rotation, emit a warning when active session flips to a different scope.

sam: agree. Also add a small note in the onboarding template about long-lived streams: rotating project keys should gracefully cold-start to new connection, not reuse org key silently.

mike: can we add a small failing test in the sampleapp CI that ensures project env beats org env? Might prevent regression.

jess: putting a tiny unit test in `sampleapp/auth_test.sh` is perfect. I'll open a PR with the resolver fix and README updates.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=jess/cli-auth-resolver-fix to staging (eta 5m) :rocket:

aisha: thanks — after PR lands can we run a manual onboarding checklist with a new account? I'll do a quick playthrough and report back. :thumbsup:

mike: sweet. low-risk patch but high DX impact. Appreciate it.
